name: Motion Studio
description: Programmatic motion written by the Palette LLM as a HyperFrames composition (HTML + GSAP) and rendered to MP4: kinetic text, titles and end cards, animated charts and diagrams, product showcases and turntables from a product image, stylised exploded/assembly views, and graphics placed on top of footage from another step.

motion.overlay_graphics.reason: needs the footage to place graphics on

best_for: kinetic text, titles, slogans and end cards
product showcase or turntable from a product photo
spec callouts and graphics on top of AI footage
not_good_for: photoreal people, places or live action (use Flow Video or Storyboard & Video)
true 3D-accurate exploded views of a real product (it draws a stylised diagram)
realistic products, vehicles, machines, people or places (it draws them with code shapes): use an AI footage app (Flow Video / Storyboard) and add graphics on top
profile_notes: Added 2026-11-13. HyperFrames 0.9.7 renders locally with headless Chrome + ffmpeg, always at full size (short side 1080 px: smaller frames drop text and misplace bottom-anchored layers in this renderer). Charts with data use a tested bar-chart template (the LLM only extracts the numbers; a 10 s 1920x1080 chart renders in ~21 s); other motion is LLM-written, gated by `hyperframes check` and a vision review of rendered frames. Overlay on AI footage confirmed 2026-11-13 (Flow Video clip + animated slogan, 9:16). Exploded views are stylised diagrams, not 3D-accurate. No audio of its own.
